title: BPW-2026-0453
text:
[CONSENT ITEM]
BPW-2026-0453
OCB
CD 11
ADOPT-A-MEDIAN – PACIFIC PALISADES AIGLON PLAZA GARDEN PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Office of Community Beautification to grant revocable permission to encroach within the public right-of-way, subject to listed conditions, to: Palisades Beautiful. ENCROACHMENT: Installation of a native garden with irrigation improvements at the intersections of Aiglon Street, Almar Avenue, and Tahquitz Place in Pacific Palisades in Council District 11;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue no-fee Revocable Permit for work to be performed;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue no-fee A-Permit for work to be performed;
AUTHORIZE the Office of Community Beautification to request the Bureau of Contract Administration to provide a no-fee inspection of the project; and
AUTHORIZE this Board Report to be approved ON CONSENT, based on the request of Council District 11 to expedite the installation of this project.
summary: Native garden with irrigation improvements at intersections of Aiglon Street, Almar Avenue, and Tahquitz Place in Pacific Palisades.
